_readme: Reference library of genuine packs. The entries below are DEMO placeholders (made-up manufacturer and NAFDAC numbers) so the app runs end to end. Replace them with real products you have verified against the NAFDAC Greenbook and a genuine pack bought from a licensed pharmacy. Put reference photos in public/references/ and list their file names in referenceImages.

products.packagingNotes: Blue and white carton. Batch printed as two letters followed by 4-6 digits. Dates printed as MM/YYYY.
